title: Wolfia vs Orbiq for trust centers and questionnaires
summary: Orbiq is an EU-hosted trust center for NIS2 and DORA. Wolfia answers security questionnaires and runs a trust center. How the two compare.
body_markdown:
Orbiq is an EU-hosted trust center for NIS2 and DORA. Wolfia answers security questionnaires and runs a trust center. How the two compare.


Orbiq is a trust center platform from Orbiq GmbH in Hamburg, built for EU B2B teams that work under NIS2 and DORA. Wolfia is an AI agent for security questionnaires, contract review and the trust center, and this page sets the two side by side using only what each company publishes.


## What Orbiq is


Orbiq’s homepage says, “Run trust operations for NIS2 and DORA with a branded trust center, vendor assurance, and incident-ready workflows built for EU B2B teams.” Its trust center publishes security documentation and gates sensitive documents behind public, email-gated, NDA-gated and request-based access levels, and Orbiq says it is hosted in the EU (Germany) and has been ISO 27001 certified since November 2026. The homepage also describes AI answers to inbound questionnaires and RFPs that are “Grounded in the same evidence you publish in the Trust Center.” A separate AI questionnaires product builds and sends security questionnaires to a company’s own vendors and collects their evidence.


## What Wolfia is


Wolfia is an AI agent for security questionnaires, contract review and the trust center. It answers security questionnaires, DDQs and RFPs from a company’s own documents and past answers, gives every answer a cited source, and leaves an answer empty when no document supports it. It works on Excel, Word and PDF files and exports them in their original format, and a Chrome extension fills answers back into web portals. The[Wolfia facts page](https://wolfia.com/facts) lists the rest, including hosting on Amazon Web Services in the United States and SOC 2 Type II.


## Orbiq and Wolfia side by side


Orbiq cells come from Orbiq’s own pages, read 26 November 2026, and Wolfia cells from Wolfia’s published facts.


Orbiq Wolfia


Primary use A branded trust center for NIS2 and DORA, with vendor assurance and incident workflows, for EU B2B teams An AI agent for security questionnaires, contract review and the trust center


Security questionnaires Homepage describes AI answers to “NIS2-era questionnaires” grounded in trust center evidence Answers security questionnaires and DDQs from your own documents and past answers ([Questionnaire Agent](https://wolfia.com/products/questionnaire-automation) )


File formats Not stated on Orbiq’s site Excel, Word and PDF, exported back in the original format


Web portals Not stated on Orbiq’s site The Chrome extension extracts the questions from web portals and fills the answers back ([Chrome Extension Agent](https://wolfia.com/products/chrome-extension) )


Trust center Branded portal with public, email-gated, NDA-gated and request-based access levels Access requests and online NDA signing, where one signed NDA carries across documents ([Trust Center](https://wolfia.com/products/trust-center) )


RFPs Homepage says “Automate 300-question RFPs with AI.” Answers RFPs from the same documents and past answers


Contract review Not stated on Orbiq’s site AI contract review and obligation tracking, with redlines exported as tracked changes ([Customer Contract Intelligence](https://wolfia.com/products/customer-contract-intelligence) )


Knowledge sources Integrations listed include Google Drive, Confluence, Slack and DocuSign, and the homepage names SharePoint as a sync source; content integrations start on the Team plan Including Google Drive, Confluence, SharePoint, OneDrive, GitHub, GitLab, Glean, Guru, Slab, Mintlify and Letter AI ([Knowledge Base Agent](https://wolfia.com/products/knowledge-base-agent) )


Citations Answers come “with references back to your Trust Center” Every answer comes with a cited source


Human review Homepage says “Sales, legal, or security tweak answers before sending.” Your subject matter experts review the drafts and only handle the questions where Wolfia is unsure or found no source ([Questionnaire Agent](https://wolfia.com/products/questionnaire-automation) )


Pricing Free €0 a year; Team €85 a month or €850 a year; Business from €190 a month or €1,900 a year; Enterprise custom Plans start at $500 a month ([Pricing](https://wolfia.com/pricing) )


Pricing model Priced per plan, billed monthly or yearly; Free is limited to one user, and Team and above include unlimited team members Every plan covers security questionnaires, contract reviews and the trust center, with unlimited users; pricing scales with volume, not headcount


Hosting region EU (Germany) Amazon Web Services in the United States ([Wolfia trust center](https://trust.wolfia.com/) )


Certifications ISO 27001, certified since November 2026; SOC 2 not stated on Orbiq’s site SOC 2 Type II, and certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework


Free trial Seven-day free trial of the paid plan, and a forever-free plan with one admin and 20 access grants a year A “Get started for free” sign-up on wolfia.com; paid plans are scoped on one short call ([Pricing](https://wolfia.com/pricing) )


## Where Wolfia is ahead


Each point below is backed by the table above or by the page it links.


- Contract review is part of every Wolfia plan, with obligation tracking and redlines exported as tracked changes. Orbiq’s site does not state contract review.
- Wolfia answers questionnaires in Excel, Word and PDF files and fills answers back into web portals with its Chrome extension. Orbiq’s site does not state file formats or portal support.
- One Wolfia plan covers security questionnaires, contract reviews and the trust center, with unlimited users.


## Which team each fits


Orbiq fits an EU company whose first need is a trust center hosted in the EU, with access levels and NDA gating, built for NIS2 and DORA. Its published prices, free plan and seven-day trial let a team try it before paying.


Wolfia fits a team whose main workload is inbound security questionnaires, DDQs and RFPs in files and web portals, and that wants a trust center and contract review on the same plan. Wolfia hosts customer data in the United States, so a buyer that requires EU hosting should weigh that. It also answers security questions in Slack through the[Slack Agent](https://wolfia.com/products/slack-autorespond) , and in Claude and ChatGPT through the[Wolfia connector](https://wolfia.com/blog/connect-wolfia-to-claude-and-chatgpt) .

## FAQ


### Is Orbiq a trust center or a security questionnaire tool?


Orbiq is a trust center platform for NIS2 and DORA, with vendor assurance and incident workflows. Its homepage also describes AI answers to questionnaires and RFPs, grounded in the evidence a company publishes in its Orbiq trust center.


### Where are Orbiq and Wolfia hosted?


Orbiq says it is hosted in the EU, in Germany. Wolfia hosts customer data on Amazon Web Services in the United States.


### How do Orbiq and Wolfia price their plans?


Orbiq publishes a free plan, Team at €85 a month and Business from €190 a month, plus a custom Enterprise plan. Wolfia plans start at $500 a month, cover security questionnaires, contract reviews and the trust center, and include unlimited users.


### Does Wolfia include a trust center?


Yes. Every Wolfia plan includes the trust center, with access requests and online NDA signing, where one signed NDA carries across documents.
